# Product Mission (Lite)

Rentzu is a mobile landlord bookkeeping app that helps small landlords stay tax-ready year-round by capturing rental income and expenses as they happen and turning them into clean, accountant-ready year-end summaries.

Rentzu serves small landlords — including those in Chinese-speaking communities — who either file with consumer tax software or hand their records to an accountant and need to supply complete year-end data. Unlike full tax-prep software, Rentzu focuses on rental-specific, current-year bookkeeping and low-friction (voice-enabled) capture that produces Schedule E–style, CPA-ready exports rather than filing returns.
